title: Macro StoryLine — Consumer, Inflation, Labor & Precious Metals
summary: An integrated eight-panel narrative capturing consumer sentiment, inflation momentum, labor-market dynamics, and the macro hedge response through gold.

rows.title: Growth & Expectations — Sentiment Improves as Core Eases
rows.story: Consumer expectations firm while headline and core PCE ease to 2.8%, reinforcing a soft-landing path. Real-rate pressure moderates as inflation expectations cool, supporting a more constructive demand backdrop.

rows.title: Labor Market — Claims Improve While Hiring Slows
rows.story: Initial and continuing claims eased, tempering slowdown fears. Yet private hiring momentum remains weak, with ADP contracting and signaling softer job creation into year-end. Together, the mix shows cooling—not cracking—labor conditions.

rows.title: Inflation Pressure — Services Cool While USD Pass-Through Builds
rows.story: Service-sector prices ease meaningfully, aligning with disinflation in PCE goods. However, softer USD conditions begin lifting import prices, signaling currency-driven inflation sensitivity as spreads compress.

rows.title: Precious Metals — Silver Leads, Gold Holds Breakout
rows.story: Silver’s strength and a falling gold–silver ratio reinforce the bullish precious-metals setup. Gold holds its breakout as easing odds rise and real-rate pressure softens, sustaining momentum into year-end.
